correctness.rationale: Diagonal congruence reduces any SPD arrowhead to hub and two aggregate leaf modes with s+t=R<1, annihilating orthogonal leaves. The active 3x3 GS matrix has eigenvalues {0,0,R}, P³=RP² and A-energy singular polynomial λ[λ²-(R+st)λ+st]. Its largest root yields the one-sweep squared norm, and rank-one P² gives all m>=2 norms R^(2m-4)[R³+(1-R)²st]. Differentiation shows first norm strictly decreases with p=st, later norms increase, so balanced subset vs endpoint hub order are disjoint optimizers; equal-coupling two-leaf family has unbounded 2-step ratio as R->0. Independent full-matrix numeric and exact symbolic checks confirm selected cases, proof is general algebra.
